description: CoreS3 physical voice E2E stimuli (18 cases); human evidence and device state are mandatory; OFF cannot receive a voice ON instruction without an active recognizer

cases.note: Explicit capture without relying on an AI tool choice
Negated camera request must not start capture

cases.text: カメラで見てください
こんにちは。今日の気分はどう？
cases.note: Ordinary conversation must not trigger camera

cases.text: 音量を20パーセントにして
cases.note: Check actual output and stored percent

cases.text: 音量を30パーセントにして
cases.note: Run alternating 20↔30 ten times during device acceptance
Check next turn and reboot restore

cases.text: 続けてお話ししてください
cases.note: Repeat across 30 minutes and record heap/reset reason

cases.text: 文字起こしをオンにして
cases.note: Start with conversation ON. Confirm stored transcription ON, conversation OFF, and old session closed
Transcription-only mode can run a user's exact local photo command without any cloud LLM/tool or head movement.

cases.text: 文字起こしをオフにして
cases.note: Start with transcription ON. Confirm explicit OFF persists and microphone stops
Manually set conversation ON, power-cycle CoreS3 before the trial. Confirm saved AND connected values, not just ON on screen
Manually set conversation+transcription OFF, power-cycle CoreS3; sending stimulus must not activate microphone or cloud. Prove this via active monitor and physical output
Hardware observation for the previously working #32 motion; do not claim motor movement from a tool acknowledgement
Measure physical tilt direction and return to safe pose if testing fails
